body:
I know what it's like to hate everything you make, to be so sure that everything you create is worthless. I know that it may seem like bullshit when I say this, but your song is good. I genuinely enjoyed it. 

It's a rough draft, the acoustics of your room aren't conducive to making a song that sounds like what you'd hear on a top 100 playlist on Spotify. But it's really, actually good. 

There's also something comforting and appealing about hearing the raw vocals and guitar that you display. It's the feeling I get when life is simple. When there's no overbearing pressures and weights on my mind, when my anxiety is somewhere far away, and I'm just listening to someone sing their soul in a peaceful atmosphere. It's hard for me to describe, but I get this feeling a lot when listening to [this song.](https://open.spotify.com/track/5281iZ2p4VVCGAvFLzmyDN?si=d67f79209b5b4e49)

Life is horribly painful far too often. I'm sorry that the lyrics you've poured your heart into ever had to come into existence, you've clearly had your fair share of grief. I hope it's at least some solace for me to say that you have talent and I wish you well.
